market.question: Will the highest temperature in Amsterdam be 17°C on April 29?

assessment.reasoning: Met Office forecast for Amsterdam Schiphol April 29: ~53°F (~12°C) high. The 17°C bucket would require a high of ~17°C (62.6°F), about 5°C above forecast. Very unlikely. Estimate ~5-10%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast precision; warm-up surprises possible but unlikely magnitude.
